description: This file contains utility functions for mapping CSV lines to internal data structures, converting database query rows to internal models, generating denormalized and persisted data representations, and handling diff/commit data transformations in a version control analysis system.

methods.name: CSVLineToDiffRow
methods.description: Converts a CSV line represented as string slices into a DiffRow entity, after validating column length and converting necessary fields.

methods.name: CSVLineToCommitRow
methods.description: Converts a CSV line into a CommitRow entity, validating column length.

methods.name: batchToInts
methods.description: Converts multiple string representations of integers into a slice of integers.

methods.name: diffRowToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Transforms an analyzed diff row into a denormalized list of columns for reporting.

methods.name: commitRowToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Transforms an analyzed commit row into a denormalized list of columns for reporting.

methods.name: diffRowToPersistCols
methods.description: Transforms an analyzed diff row into a persistence-ready list of column values.

methods.name: commitRowToPersistCols
methods.description: Transforms an analyzed commit row into a persistence-ready list of column values.

methods.name: DiffRowsToPersistCols
methods.description: Converts a list of diff rows into a list suitable for database persistence, assigning UUIDs.

methods.name: DiffRowsToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Converts a list of diff rows into denormalized columns for reporting.

methods.name: CommitRowsToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Converts a list of commit rows into denormalized columns for reporting, using commit-to-timestamp map.

methods.name: DiffRowsToAggregateChangesOverTime
methods.description: Aggregates diff rows over time to generate summary metrics.

methods.name: getSumOfAttribute
methods.description: Sums a specific attribute over a list of diff rows based on provided getter function.

methods.name: CommitRowsToPersistCols
methods.description: Converts commit rows into database persistence format, assigning UUIDs.

methods.name: SQLRowToDiffRow
methods.description: Converts a SQL row to an analyzed diff row object.

methods.name: SQLRowToCommitRow
methods.description: Converts a SQL row to an analyzed commit row object.

methods.name: PrependMappedDiffTarget
methods.description: Prepends diff target info to denormalized rows.

methods.name: AppendDiffTarget
methods.description: Appends diff target info to rows of data for reporting.

methods.name: SHA256HexDigest
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hex digest of an input string.

methods.name: GetAuthorTechArea
methods.description: Determines tech area of author based on email hash.
